GOVT OF JAMMU AND KASHMIR
DISTRICT EMPLOYMENT & COUNSELING CENTRE, BANDIPORA
Email Id: addeccbandipora@gmail.com Phone No: 01957225228
INTERVIEW NOTICE
In continuation to the Advertisement Notice No. DE&CC/Bpr/2026-27/139-42 dated
28.04.2026, regarding the engagement of a Coordinator on contractual basis in the Business
Help Desk (BHD) under Mission YUVA, the candidates shortlisted by the District Level Selection
Oversight Committee are hereby informed that their interview/viva-voce shall be conducted as
per the schedule given below:
 Date of Interview: 03 July 2026
 Venue: V.C Room Mini Secretariat, Bandipora.
 Reporting Time: 03:00 P.M
The list of shortlisted candidates (Annexure–A) has been prepared on the basis of points
awarded as per the prescribed evaluation criteria and subsequent scrutiny by the oversight
selection Committee. The shortlisting is purely provisional, subject to verification of
documents and certificates.
Important Instructions for Candidates:
1. Candidates must produce all original documents/testimonials in support of their
eligibility, educational qualifications, experience certificates, and domicile/residence
proof.
2. Any candidate failing to produce original documents or found ineligible at the time of
interview shall be disqualified without further notice.
3. No separate call letters shall be issued. This notice shall be treated as an official
intimation for interview.
4. Candidates are advised to bring one set of self-attested photocopies of all required
documents along with two passport size photographs.
5. Candidates are required to report at the venue at least 30 minutes prior to the
scheduled time
6. No TA/DA shall be paid for appearing in the interview.
Member Secretary
Assistant Director Employment,
Bandipora
No: DE&CC/Bpr /MY/2026-27/388-93

5. District Informatics Officer, Bandipora with the request to upload this notice on District
Administration Website.
6. District Information Officer, Bandipora for information and with the request to ensure the
publication of this notice on social media handles of district administration Bandipora.
